design_note: Four atomic reference facts cover a 6-year-old daughter, nightly anal itching for 1 week, waking from sleep each night, and red perianal scratch marks today without naming threadworms or pinworms, with a 2-word span difference (18 vs 20 words) and identical digit multisets across all 5 variants. Under reviewer_notes Rule A and Rule D, replacing f4 ('red scratch marks around her bottom') at the exact same perianal site with 'painful dark red tissue bulging from her bottom' keeps every prior perianal fact directly coherent while escalating care unambiguously from outpatient clinic (level 2) to ER reduction for acute painful pediatric rectal prolapse (level 4) with zero stated negatives.
